workflow.title: Chase overdue invoices with escalating reminders
workflow.goal: Send payment reminders to customers with open, overdue invoices from the invoices sheet. Tone starts friendly and gets firmer the longer an invoice is overdue. Disputed invoices are not chased. Each reminder is signed as Hannah at Little Fern Bakery.

assumptions: Only invoices with status 'open' and a due date before the run date are chased; 'disputed' and 'paid' invoices are skipped.
Escalation: under 15 days overdue is friendly, 15 to 30 days is firm, 31 days or more is final.
Each outbound email is approved by a person before it is sent.
risks: Customers who opted out in the CRM are not checked, so a reminder could go to someone who unsubscribed.
A customer with several overdue invoices receives one reminder per invoice.
If the invoices sheet is out of date, reminders may show wrong amounts or dates.
A reminder may reach a customer who is already disputing a bill with us, even though their own invoice is not marked disputed.
successCriteria: Every open overdue invoice (not disputed or paid) gets exactly one reminder email, or is skipped if a person declines it.
Each email uses the tone that matches its days overdue and is signed Hannah @ Little Fern Bakery.
The outbox audit confirms the sent recipients match the expected list.

nodes.description: Read every row of the invoices sheet.
Add daysOverdue: whole days between each invoice's due date and now (positive when past due).
Keep only open invoices that are past due. Disputed and paid invoices are excluded.
Set the reminder tone for each overdue invoice: friendly under 15 days, firm 15 to 30 days, final 31 days or more.

Hi Pine & Co Catering,

This is our final reminder before we take further steps. Our records show that invoice LF-203 for 560 was due on 2026-09-10 and is still unpaid (41 days overdue).

Please pay within 7 days or contact us today to agree a plan. If there's a problem with this invoice, reply and we'll look into it.

Thanks,
Hannah
Little Fern Bakery
